quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #22
										  					
  

30 Questions • Passing Score 24

questions.question: The road has a solid yellow line and a broken yellow line in the center. The broken line is next to your lane. When may you pass?
questions.correctAnswerText: When traffic is clear.
questions.explanation: When the broken yellow line is next to your lane, you may cross it to pass if no oncoming traffic is coming.

questions.question: A leaky exhaust system is dangerous because it can cause:
questions.correctAnswerText: Carbon monoxide poisoning.
questions.explanation: The exhaust system removes dangerous gases from your vehicle. A leak lets poisonous carbon monoxide into the passenger area. Fix any exhaust leaks right away.

questions.question: You are crossing an intersection. An emergency vehicle with sirens and flashing lights is approaching. What should you do?

options.text: Pull to the right of the intersection and stop.
Finish crossing the intersection, then pull to the right and stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Finish crossing the intersection, then pull to the right and stop.
questions.explanation: If you are in an intersection when an emergency vehicle approaches with lights or sirens, finish crossing. Then drive to the right and stop. Always yield to emergency vehicles.

questions.question: Why is it important to watch for motorcycles?

options.text: They are harder to see than cars.
Motorcycle riders are less skilled than other drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: They are harder to see than cars.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles are smaller and easier to miss than cars. They can hide in your blind spot. It is hard to judge how far away a motorcycle is or how fast it is going. Always stay alert around motorcycles.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to stop.
You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: A stop sign is the only eight-sided sign on the road. You must come to a complete stop. Do not go until it is safe and clear to pass through the intersection.

questions.question: A driver's left arm is extended downward. What does this hand signal mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Stop.
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm points down, they are signaling they will stop. Change your driving if you are following this driver.

questions.question: What is the best way to avoid a dangerous situation while driving?

options.text: Know what is happening around your vehicle.
Always keep your eyes focused straight ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Know what is happening around your vehicle.
questions.explanation: Always be aware of what is happening around your vehicle. Watch in front, to the sides, and behind. This helps you see problems and change speed or position safely.

questions.question: You are driving on a highway with two solid yellow lines. When may you cross these lines?

options.text: Only to turn left into an alley, private road, or driveway.
To pass other vehicles if no oncoming traffic is coming.

questions.correctAnswerText: Only to turn left into an alley, private road, or driveway.
questions.explanation: Double solid yellow lines mean no passing from either direction. You may only cross them to turn left into an alley, private road, or driveway.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people crossing your path.

questions.correctAnswerText: Work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This orange sign warns you that road work is coming up. Stay alert for temporary traffic control signs in work zones.

questions.question: When getting into a parked vehicle, you should:

options.text: Enter only from the passenger side door.
Signal oncoming traffic to stop so you can open the driver door.
Look for any obstacles that could affect safe driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look for any obstacles that could affect safe driving.
questions.explanation: Check around your vehicle before entering. Walk around it to see that the path is clear and safe.

questions.question: Traffic signals sometimes show arrows to control turns from specific lanes. What does a solid red arrow mean?

options.text: It is never used as a traffic signal.
It means the same thing as a circular red light.
Drivers may turn in the direction the arrow points.
Traffic in that direction must stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: It means the same thing as a circular red light.
questions.explanation: A solid red arrow means the same thing as a circular red light. Drivers must stop and cannot turn in the direction the arrow points.

questions.question: Why should you not use high beam headlights in fog or mist?

options.text: The light reflects back into your eyes.
Oncoming vehicles might not see you.
Vehicles behind you may follow too closely.

questions.correctAnswerText: The light reflects back into your eyes.
questions.explanation: In fog or mist, high beam headlights reflect the light back into your eyes, making it harder to see.

questions.question: When a green arrow changes to a solid green light, what should you do?

options.text: You may turn, but you must yield to oncoming traffic.
You cannot turn and must go straight.
You still have the right-of-way to turn.
You no longer have to turn in the arrow's direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may turn, but you must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: When a green arrow becomes a solid green light, you may still turn in the arrow's direction. However, you must first yield to pedestrians and oncoming traffic.

questions.question: Alcohol is a:
questions.correctAnswerText: Depressant.
questions.explanation: Alcohol is a depressant. It slows your judgment and makes your reflexes slower and less reliable.

questions.question: You must notify SCDMV of a name or address change within how many days?
questions.correctAnswerText: 10 days
questions.explanation: You must tell SCDMV about any name or address change within 10 days.

questions.question: When making an emergency roadside stop, you do not need to use your parking brake.
questions.correctAnswerText: False
questions.explanation: You should set your parking brake during an emergency roadside stop. Also turn on your emergency flashers to warn other drivers.

questions.question: What color are regulatory signs?
questions.correctAnswerText: White
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs tell drivers about traffic laws they must follow. These signs are usually white squares or rectangles with black, red, or green words or symbols.

questions.question: What should you do when driving in bad weather?
questions.correctAnswerText: Steer and brake smoothly.
questions.explanation: In bad weather, avoid sudden braking and sharp turns. These actions make it harder to control your vehicle.

questions.question: When changing lanes, you should:

options.text: Signal as you start to move into the next lane.
Signal 500 feet before changing lanes on residential streets.

questions.correctAnswerText: Always check your blind spot.
questions.explanation: Other cars and motorcycles can hide in your blind spot. Look over your shoulder before changing lanes. Signal 100 feet before changing lanes on residential streets. Signal five seconds in advance on freeways.

questions.question: At intersections, crosswalks, and railroad crossings, you should always:

options.text: Look to both sides of your vehicle.
Slowly pass vehicles that appear to be stopped for no reason.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look to both sides of your vehicle.
questions.explanation: At places where people may cross or where traffic lines meet, look left and right to make sure nothing is coming.

questions.question: You must stop completely, yield to other traffic and pedestrians, and then go when it is safe. This matches which traffic light?
questions.correctAnswerText: A flashing red light.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means the same as a stop sign. Stop completely, yield to other traffic and pedestrians, then go when it is safe.

questions.question: You see a flashing red light at an intersection. What must you do?

options.text: Slow down and drive carefully through the intersection.
Turn right or left because the road ahead is blocked.
Stop and wait for a flashing green light.
Stop, then go when traffic allows.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop, then go when traffic allows.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means you must stop completely. Then you can go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does a broken yellow centerline mean?

options.text: You can pass on the right when the way is clear.
You can pass on the left when the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can pass on the left when the way is clear.
questions.explanation: A broken yellow centerline means you can cross it to pass another car on the left if no cars are coming the other way. Never cross a solid yellow centerline to pass.

questions.question: The speed limit in a neighborhood is usually 30 mph.
questions.correctAnswerText: True
questions.explanation: The maximum speed limit in a residential area is usually 30 miles per hour.

questions.question: Traffic is blocking an intersection ahead of you. What should you do?

options.text: Get as close as possible to the car in front.
Stay out of the intersection until you can go all the way through.
Honk your horn to make cars move.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay out of the intersection until you can go all the way through.
questions.explanation: Do not enter the intersection if traffic is backed up on the other side and you cannot get all the way through. Wait until traffic ahead clears so you do not block the intersection.

questions.question: You are leaving the interstate. When should you start slowing down?

options.text: As you approach the exit lane.
Right when you enter the exit lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Right when you enter the exit lane.
questions.explanation: Keep your speed when leaving the interstate until you enter the exit lane. Then slow down to the speed shown on the exit ramp sign.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an intersection is ahead. A road joins from the right.

questions.question: Railroad crossings should always be considered:

options.text: Safe to cross because trains rarely come.
A place where you must stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Dangerous.
questions.explanation: Railroad crossings are always dangerous. Look and listen for trains from both directions. Follow all signs, signals, and flaggers. Only cross when you are sure it is safe.

questions.question: When you cannot see well while driving, what should you do first?

options.text: Look for road markings to guide you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down.
questions.explanation: Slow down first when you cannot see well. This is the most important thing to do when driving conditions are dangerous.

questions.question: You see a steady green arrow on the traffic signal. What can you do?

options.text: Move into the lane that the arrow points to.
Slow down and stop if it is safe.
Turn in the direction of the arrow after letting other traffic and pedestrians pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn in the direction of the arrow after letting other traffic and pedestrians pass.
questions.explanation: A green arrow means you can turn in that direction. You must be in the correct lane. Let any traffic or pedestrians already in the intersection go first.
